senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. סוּף II) reed, bulrush.—ים ס׳ the sea of Suf (Red Sea).
units: Sot. 12ᵃ sq. (ref. to בסוף, Ex. II, 3) ר״א אומר ים ס׳ וכ׳ R. E. says, that means the sea; R. S. says, it means ăgam (v. אֲגַם II, 2); Ex. R. s. 1.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 22:3">Ex. R. s. 22</cite> <he>קריעת ים ס׳</he> the splitting of the Red Sea (for the passage of the Israelites); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:6:6">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> bot.; a. fr.
